headline: Mostly clean: two transfer codes fit a persistent customer waving flyers, but the knowledge base's 'highest tier wins' rule picks the gold code.

issues.summary: Tier-2 'unconfirmed_external_communication' literally describes a customer holding a flyer for an offer the agent cannot find, and Tier-1 'customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal' also applies. The doc's precedence rule resolves the overlap toward the gold.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042: "Reasons are organized into 4 priority tiers - always select from the highest tier that applies."

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042 (Tier 1): "customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal | Customer asked about offers/promotions that don't exist in the system, you informed them the offers aren't available, customer persisted multiple times, and now demands human"

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042 (Tier 2): "unconfirmed_external_communication | Customer claims a specific promotion/program/offer exists (they have a letter, email, or flyer) but you cannot verify or find it in the KB after searching"
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that matches on the word 'flyer' and skips the tier rule would choose the Tier-2 code and fail the ACTION check. A careful agent resolves it correctly.
issues.suggested_fix: Add to the Tier-2 row: 'use only when the customer has not been refused repeatedly and is not demanding a human; otherwise use customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal.'

solution_check: None of the three flyer offers is available to a non-business customer on 2025-11-14. No $1,000-for-$10,000 or 3-year 0% FTF offer exists; the only first-year fee waiver for a personal card is Platinum's, which ran 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31 and is expired (Diamond Elite's waiver is invitation-only, Business Platinum's is business-only). After 8 refusals the customer demands a human, which satisfies every Tier-1 condition, so the reason is customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal, matching the gold.
prior_note: Same Minor code-overlap finding as v1.0.0; it is ACTION-graded on reason only, so the prior relaxed scorer did not affect it.
notes: ACTION grading accepts any matching call and ignores extra calls, so an agent that transferred twice with different reasons would pass (lenient, not invalid). Grading model checked against snapshot fc0055d (tag v1.0.1): EnvironmentEvaluator replays gold on a fresh env and compares get_db_hash/get_user_db_hash (both hash the one shared TransactionalDB); _derive_read_log_allowlist collects agent_tool_name from gold call_discoverable_agent_tool actions; call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool parse JSON with parse_int=float; apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float itself; Action.compare_with_tool_call matches by name plus compare_args (all agent-passed args when compare_args is None; always true when compare_args is []); get_now() is fixed at 2025-11-14 03:40:00 and get_current_time returns 'The current time is 2025-11-14 03:40:00 EST.'. Nuance: 'writes are logged even when the tool returns an error string' is only partly true. Many write paths return before touching the DB (apply_for_credit_card with an invalid card_type, call_discoverable_agent_tool on an unknown/not-unlocked tool or bad JSON, user discoverable tools not yet given).
